# AzStudy — Study in Azerbaijan

> Compare accredited Azerbaijani universities, programs, tuition and scholarships, then apply with expert guidance — visa and residence support included.

## What We Do

AzStudy is a free study-in-Azerbaijan platform that helps international students:
- Compare 46+ Azerbaijani universities (state and private)
- Browse programs in Medicine, Engineering, Business, IT, Arts and more
- Compare tuition fees ($600-15,000/year) and living costs ($400-600/month)
- Apply for scholarships (government and university-based)
- Get visa and residence permit guidance
- Read student reviews from 10,000+ international students

- [ADA University](https://azstudy.edu.az/en/universities/azerbaijan-diplomatic-academy) — Founded 2006, English-medium, $3,000-7,000/year

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does it cost to study in Azerbaijan?
State universities charge $600-2,500/year. Private universities range from $3,000-15,000/year. Living costs are $400-600/month in Baku.

### Are degrees from Azerbaijan recognized internationally?
Yes. Azerbaijan Medical University is WHO-recognized. Most degrees are recognized across CIS, EU, and Middle East countries.

### Can I study in English in Azerbaijan?
Yes. ADA University teaches all programs in English. BSU, UNEC, Khazar, and BHOS also offer English-taught programs.

### How do I apply for an Azerbaijani university?
Visit azstudy.edu.az, choose your university, prepare documents (passport, diploma, transcripts), and submit online. Applications take 2-4 weeks to process.

### Are there scholarships for international students?
Yes. The Azerbaijani government offers full scholarships (tuition + stipend + accommodation). Universities also offer merit-based awards from 25-100% tuition coverage.

### Is Azerbaijan safe for international students?
Yes. Azerbaijan ranks among the top 30 safest countries globally. Baku has modern infrastructure and a welcoming multicultural environment.

## Country Facts

- **Location**: South Caucasus, between Europe and Asia
- **Capital**: Baku (population 2.3 million)
- **Language**: Azerbaijani (Turkic family), Russian, English widely spoken
- **Currency**: Azerbaijani Manat (AZN) — 1 AZN ≈ $0.59
- **Climate**: 4 seasons — mild winters, warm summers
- **Time Zone**: GMT+4
- **International Students**: 10,000+ from 100+ countries
